coverage.method: Sitemap/navigation discovery, page-family HTML/CSS inspection, selected browser screenshots and runtime probes where permitted.
coverage.viewports: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile; not every source page was rendered.
coverage.limits: Public page families sampled, not every article, locale, private app or interaction state. Source-only theme/motion declarations are not runtime verification.

color.action: Dark ink-filled download pill with white label; the old blue gradient CTA is not current.
color.role: Warm near-white monochrome page. Blue and other saturated colors come mainly from the app icon and screenshots, not a semantic marketing palette.

typography.fonts: SN Pro variable 200–900 with system sans fallback; current English and Chinese share the declared stack. CJK glyphs fall back to system fonts.
typography.heading: Home h1 is a modest 15/28, weight 500 in both locales; the page opens as a personal product note, not a display hero.
typography.body: 15px, weight 400; long-form paragraph rhythm around 28px. Root line-height 22.5px; nav link 14/20.
typography.hierarchy: Weight, paragraph spacing and screenshots do the work. No new-spirit serif identity or 24px Chinese heading in the current homepage.

layout.width: 528px content rail at 1440px; 342px at 390px (24px side insets).
layout.structure: Compact navigation → personal narrative paragraphs → product screenshots and explanatory prose → purchase/download information → small footer.
layout.mobile: Same reading column and visible navigation; content wraps naturally. No hamburger or multi-column collapse needed.
layout.changelog: English and Chinese dated release pages, using heading + release entries rather than a marketing card grid.

shape.buttons: Compact black pill download action; native app icon; rounded screenshots.
shape.surfaces: Plain reading surface without elevated feature cards; image rounding supplies the main container shape.

elevation.style: Subtle screenshot/icon frame treatment; page text is flat. Do not reuse the old blue CTA glow or pricing-card recipe.

components.nav: App icon/Minshot left, Changelog and black Download for Mac pill right; retained at 390px.
components.prose: Small medium-weight opening sentence, muted readable paragraphs, selective bold product statement.
components.media: Large inline native-app screenshots inside the narrow column; native window effects are baked into the media.
components.release_notes: Dated headings and concise feature/fix details in the same language as the selected locale.

motion.observed: No document animations or canvas on either homepage locale.
motion.scope: Static presentation; no inference about the desktop application runtime.

design_style.composition: A narrow long-form letter, with small typography and actual screenshots as evidence; abundant outer whitespace.
design_style.imagery: Native macOS UI, screen frames and backgrounds shown inside static media.
design_style.voice: First-person explanation of a practical daily workflow; avoid expanding it into a conventional giant SaaS hero.

visual_effects.technology: Static images and CSS. Zero canvas and zero active document animations in inspected English/Chinese homepage samples.
visual_effects.materials: Any glass, backdrop or perspective in the screenshots belongs to the captured product image; it is not a page-level effect.
visual_effects.interaction: Simple color feedback, black pill action, natural document scrolling.
visual_effects.scope: Private app, checkout and unobserved interaction states are outside this profile.

page_families./; /zh: Same SN Pro narrow product-note composition in English/Chinese.
page_families./changelog; /zh/changelog: Dated release list in the same quiet typography; both source pages refreshed.
